title: Speculative Web tool presentation contract
description: Optional package-owned metadata for future graphical and card-based tool presentation. The frontend may render this data but must not duplicate method logic or use it as an executor input.

card_kind.description: Stable card family token, such as method, analysis, consequence, or artifact.

icon_token.description: Design-system icon token; the frontend maps it to a graphic without restating tool theory.

accent_token.description: Optional design-system accent token, not a hardcoded colour value.

path.description: Optional path relative to this tool package. Absolute and parent-directory paths are invalid.

summary_fields.description: Package fields a compact card should surface.

interaction_hint.description: Short package-owned prompt describing when the card should be opened.
